title: Karma: define and implement a reader reputation number
description:
As a reader, I want my contributions to build a visible reputation, so that good contributors are recognised and trusted.

Decision (2026-10-21): karma is needed. Define the model first and record it on this story before implementing: which events add or subtract (submissions that reach a good outcome, ratings that agree with later editor judgement, moderation outcomes, reports upheld), decay, caps, abuse resistance (new accounts, vote rings), and where karma gates things (rate limits, voting weight, track-record rules). Karma is shown only once it is a defined number. Until it ships, UI shows submission count and account age.

```gherkin
Feature: Karma
  Scenario: Earn
    Given a reader's submission is confirmed by an editor
    Then the reader's karma increases by the documented amount

  Scenario: Lose
    Given a reader's content is hidden by moderation
    Then karma decreases by the documented amount

  Scenario: Public display
    Then karma is shown beside the handle only when the publication has karma enabled

  Scenario: Gate
    Given a karma threshold for a privilege
    Then readers below it are limited, and readers above it are not
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reconciliation 2026-10-22. Partly done. Exists: v1 formula (upvotes from others x karma.upvoteWeight + used-it reports x karma.usedItWeight; own votes excluded), materialised on ReaderProfile.karma by the snapshot, top-50 readers.json, and the ReaderSignIn island shows it (Papyrus #516, docs/reader-steering.md 'Karma'). Karma is 0 for everyone: its inputs (reader submissions, submitter_of) do not exist yet. Remains: record the full karma model on this story (earn and lose events, decay, caps, abuse resistance), implement it once submissions exist (PPY-5b8cdc), moderation penalties (PPY-af98c7), and the privilege gates.
